CustomField.description: Count of open Cases on this Opportunity not yet Submitted to Support. A Case only reaches Submitted_To_Support__c = true through the seller's own action, and that action is only available once the Case Detail fields and intake documents are both complete — so this count covers pending field values, pending documents, or a fully-ready Case just waiting to be submitted, as one signal.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many Cases on this Opportunity still need your attention — either information/documents to complete, or ready and waiting for you to click Submit to Support.
CustomField.label: Open Cases Pending Seller Action
